post.title: 🌸🌸🌸 these water bowls will help stray animals during these difficult summer months to hydrate and stay cool!! I sincerely request all those who can to pls get these mitti bowls or even mitti bowls from your own local potters and place them outside your buildings! Pls tag @jf.yolofoundation @thefelinefoundation so we can repost your amazing work and spread the word!!! I got my mitti bowls from the @thefelinefoundation thank you so much for this amazing initiative 💜 also the water bowls need to be cleaned and refilled daily to avoid stagnant water and to keep it fresh and hygienic for the community!
